title: Train braking failure
goal: Show the logic by which pneumatic and dynamic braking can both be unavailable.

rubric.must: A top event labelled Train unable to achieve required braking is visibly at the head of the tree.
The tree visibly shows both bogie brake-controller failures at an AND gate.
The picture visibly separates pneumatic and dynamic brake loss branches.
Every leaf-level basic event visibly carries a plausible probability.
OR and AND gate symbols visibly distinguish the stated failure logic.
A computed probability or cut-set summary is visible without obscuring the tree.
